# Watershed

> > Watershed appears to be a digital portal aggregating Microsoft 365 productivity services and TV Guide entertainment content.

This site provides access to Microsoft account management, Microsoft 365 Copilot AI-powered productivity tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook), and comprehensive TV listings with streaming recommendations across Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Peacock, HBO Max, and other platforms.

## Key Topics

- Microsoft 365 Copilot
- TV Guide
- AI-powered productivity
- Streaming services (Netflix, Hulu, Prime Video, Peacock, HBO Max, Paramount+)
- Account management and authentication
- Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook)
- TV listings and schedules
- Entertainment and celebrity news
- Document collaboration
- Show and streaming recommendations
- AI integration
- TV reviews and online videos

## Microsoft 365 & Productivity

- [Microsoft 365 Copilot | Create, Share and Collaborate with Office and AI](https://office.com): Microsoft 365 Copilot hub for Word, Excel, PowerPoint collaboration with AI
- [Microsoft account | Sign In or Create Your Account Today – Microsoft](https://account.microsoft.com/account): Microsoft account sign-in and creation portal supporting multiple providers

## TV & Entertainment

- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Streaming Services, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com): TV Guide homepage with streaming recommendations and entertainment news
- [TV Guide, TV Listings, Online Videos, Entertainment News and Celebrity News - TV Guide](https://tvguide.com/Listings): TV Guide schedule and listings by provider for shows, movies, and programs
